subject: S04 needs apps/api/pyproject.toml, uv.lock, requirements.txt, naadi_api/main.py, api.py: when can you release?
body: S04 (agent platform) adds Python deps (aegra-api 0.11.0, langgraph, langchain-openrouter, tavily-python, biopython, langgraph-sdk) and must change main.py (Aegra becomes the top-level ASGI process hosting naadi_api.main:app; lifespan hooks for the LLM layer) and api.py (/api/health gains agent_runtime). You hold claim 20261116T075911-seg03-auth-506ab3 on those files. I am working on my own files (llm.py, search.py, agent/**) meanwhile and will keep my pyproject/main.py edits small and additive (new deps appended, uv lock regenerated on rebase). Please reply with: (a) release now, or (b) the time you expect to integrate + release, so I rebase onto your sha. I will not touch these files on claude/naadi-shared until you answer.
